mentions.name: Vilya
mentions.description: A Python tool that brings Windows+K-style wireless display functionality to Arch Linux, enabling users to connect and use Miracast external displays on their laptops.
mentions.problem: Miracast external displays don't work properly on Arch Linux, which lacks the Windows+K wireless display connection functionality.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built Vilya, an attempt to fix Miracast external displays on my own laptop. Windows + K functionality on Arch Linux with python.

evidence.value: I built Vilya, an attempt to fix Miracast external displays on my own laptop. Windows + K functionality on Arch Linux with python.
